newsitem.title: USA: Digi names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Digi names chief financial officer.

text.p: Digi International Inc said Thursday it named Jonathon Killmer as vice president of finance and administration, chief financial officer and treasurer.
Killmer replaces Gerald Wall who will be leaving the company to pursue other interests.

Killmer has been a managing partner of the Coopers & Lybrand Twin Cities offices for the past six years and was a managing partner of the accounting firm's St. Louis office for 15 years prior to that.
Digi provides data communications hardware and software for multiuser environments, remote access and local area network (LAN) connect markets.
